verdict.rationale: Cline explicitly supports multi-provider model choice: BYOK for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, local models via Ollama/LM Studio, separate model selection per Plan/Act mode, a unified Cline provider to switch between hosted models, and explicit messaging that users are never locked into one provider/pricing. Community evidence corroborates local model (Ollama) and Gemini usage alongside Anthropic. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of full provider parity/quality across all providers.
